normalization: Within each message, paragraph whitespace collapsed to one ASCII space; normalized messages joined with one ASCII space; UTF-8 without BOM; no terminal newline.

selections.resolved_meaning: Command Center remains the primary H-CAM operator dashboard with a dense command workspace and additional grouped detail pages. GIS Center is a connected specialist dashboard, not the main application.
Use hybrid bounded viewport features, vector tiles, authoritative paginated lists, and typed detail operations.
Use local or offline map resources by default and design a disabled-by-default typed provider registry for later exact allowlisted integrations.
Use server-authoritative spatial aggregates with deterministic display-only clustering.
Use a versioned server situation snapshot with per-source freshness, completeness, loss, degradation, revision, and drill-down.
Use bounded UTC windows, accepted operational timezone display, separate event and recorded time, and visible correction and retraction state.
Use server-provided safe priority bands, age, accepted authority class, and deterministic tie-breaking without client risk scoring.
Use opaque bounded URL filters, memory-only selection, and later server-owned workspaces protected by version and ETag.
Provide synchronized map and authoritative list or table equivalence with complete keyboard, focus, non-color, and bounded announcement behavior.
Keep one capability and truth model across hardware profiles while adapting only density, concurrency, rendering quality, and layout.

selections.option_source: Revised adaptive renderer options presented after the R0 decision packet.
selections.resolved_meaning: Use MapLibre as the stable 2D GIS core with optional deck.gl overlaid or interleaved rendering selected through capability and policy. Low-resource systems use MapLibre-only; enhanced systems may use overlaid mode; qualified control-room systems may use interleaved WebGL2 mode. Reverse-controlled and custom WebGL modes are excluded.
Require generated unit, component, contract, story, browser, visual, accessibility, security, deterministic replay, C1/C10/C50, GIS parity, and later manual accessibility evidence.

precedence_rules: The latest owner clarification makes Command Center primary and GIS Center a connected specialist dashboard.
D-P5.2-011 D refers to the revised adaptive MapLibre plus deck.gl option, not the original R0 custom-WebGL option.
The guarded provider registry in D-P5.2-003 does not activate any provider, network destination, credential, tile source, or external service.
The connected GIS dashboard shares domain contracts and authority with Command Center and is not a second source of operational truth.
